items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: When you did make these record dates, you know, the ones with Fats and Sonny Stitt... I was in awe, as far as versatility was concerned.

ctx.x: When you did make these record dates, you know, the ones with Fats and Sonny Stitt, what do you remember about those dates in particular?

Well, they were different than any recordings that I had been making. The versatility of the performance. I was in awe, as far as versatility was concerned. The rhythm section just had to be a (inaudible) one. A Ray Brown or Oscar Pettiford. (Unaudible)
